title: 真题演练 · 非谓语作状语
hint: 本组题目按本单元语法点与词池生成/匹配;答错后点击「回溯语法课」复习 非谓语作状语。

questions.analysis: 先考完试再放松,用 Having passed 表动作先后。

questions.q: ___ in the rain, the clothes got wet.
questions.analysis: clothes 被留在雨中,用过去分词 Left。
不定式表目的,"为了通过考试"。

questions.q: ___ from the top, the lake is like a mirror.
questions.analysis: 湖是被看的,用过去分词 Seen。

questions.q: Weather ___, we will go hiking tomorrow.
questions.analysis: 独立主格结构:名词 + 分词。

questions.q: 判断对错:Walking in the park, the flowers were beautiful.
questions.analysis: 应改为:Walking in the park, I saw beautiful flowers.。悬垂分词:分词的逻辑主语必须是句子主语。
